s.g: The twenty-first letter of the English alphabet, called u and written in the Latin script.
A U-turn ('turned a U in the road')
A double upright cordon espalier (also double U, triple U).
The name of the Latin script letter U/u.
A thing in the shape of the letter U.
A film with the film classification U (“universal”).
An honorific to a Burmese man
Usually in parentheses: abbreviation of unclassified.
A turn in a vehicle carried out by driving in a semicircle in order to travel in the opposite direction.
A reversal of policy or opinion.
ex: The government have done a U-turn and are now supporting greater European integration instead of opposing it.
